sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 568 was established by Ordinance No. 24120, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999. Ordinance No. 24120 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 568 is established on property generally located on the west line of Hampton Road, north of Kiest Boulevard. The size of PD 568 is approximately 159.0908 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) Area B is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. All other areas are considered to be residential zoning districts. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 568A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) A development plan for each area must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit within that area.

(b) The applicant shall submit a copy of each proposed development plan, landscape plan, or amendment thereto, including proposed minor amendments pursuant to Section 51A-4.702(h), to the Southwest Dallas Neighborhood Association at the address most recently furnished to the applicant in writing at least 10 days prior to filing the same with the city. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Area A.

-- Convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions. -- Medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center (limited to 25,000 square feet).

-- Private recreation center, club, or area. -- Retirement housing.

(b) Area B.

(1) Except as provided below, the uses permitted in Area B are all uses permitted in the CR Community Retail District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the CR Community Retail District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the CR Community Retail District by SUP only is permitted in this area by SUP only; a use subject to DIR in the CR Community Retail District is subject to DIR in this area; etc.

(2) The following uses are also permitted in Area B:

-- Convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions. -- Retirement housing.

(3) The following uses are not permitted in Area B:

-- Alcoholic beverage establishment. -- Ambulance service. -- Auto service center. -- Building repair or maintenance shop. -- Car wash. -- College dormitory, fraternity, or sorority house. -- Commercial amusement (inside). -- Commercial parking lot or garage. -- Electronics service center. -- Home improvement center, lumber, brick, or building materials sales yard. -- Hotel or motel. -- Household equipment and appliance repair. -- Liquor store. -- Lodging or boarding house. -- Mini-warehouse. -- Motor vehicle fueling station. -- Overnight general purpose shelter. -- Pawn shop. -- Recycling collection center. -- Restaurant with drive-in or drive-through service. -- Swap or buy shop. -- Tool or equipment rental.

(4) The area shown on the conceptual plan as “no building area” is limited to vehicular roadways and pedestrian walkways (including lighting, seating areas, and similar pedestrian amenities).

(c) Area C.

(1) Except as provided below, the uses permitted in Area C are all uses permitted in the R-10(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-10(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the R-10(A) Single Family District by SUP only is permitted in this area by SUP only; a use subject to DIR in the R-10(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this area; etc.

(2) Library, art gallery, or museum.

(d) Area D.

(1) Except as provided below, the uses permitted in Area D are all uses permitted in the R-10(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-10(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the R-10(A) Single Family District by SUP only is permitted in this area by SUP only; a use subject to DIR in the R-10(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this area; etc.

(2) Commercial stable.

(3) Private recreation center, club, or area. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Chapter 51A. In the event of a conflict between this section and Chapter 51A, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) Area A.

(A) Except as provided in Subparagraph (B) below, no minimum front yard in Area A.

(B) Minimum front yard is 25 feet for all lots that are adjacent to Areas B and D, and all lots that are along the north boundary line of Area A.

(2) Area B.

(A) Except as provided in Subparagraph (B) below, no minimum front yard in Area B.

(B) Minimum front yard is 25 feet for all lots that are adjacent to Areas A and D, and all lots along the north, east, and south boundary lines of Area B.

(3) Area C. Minimum front yard is 30 feet.

(4) Area D. Minimum front yard is 30 feet.

(b) Side and rear yards.

(1) Area A.

(A) Except as provided in Subparagraph (B) below, no minimum side and rear yard in Area A.

(B) Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet for all lots that are adjacent to Areas B and D, and all lots that are along the north boundary line of Area A.

(2) Area B.

(A) Except as provided in Subparagraphs (B) and (C) below, no minimum side and rear yard setback in Area B.

(B) Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet for all lots that are adjacent to Areas A and D, and all lots along the north and east boundary lines of Area B.

(C) A minimum setback of 25 feet is required along the south boundary line of Area B that is adjacent to Cliffteen Court.

(3) Area C.

(A) Minimum side and rear yard for single family structures is six feet.

(B) Minimum side yard for other permitted structures is 10 feet.

(C) Minimum rear yard for other permitted structures is 15 feet.

(4) Area D.

(A) Minimum side and rear yard for single family structures is six feet.

(B) Minimum side yard for other permitted structures is 10 feet.

(C) Minimum rear yard for other permitted structures is 15 feet.

(c) Floor area ratio.

(1) For nonresidential uses, maximum floor area ratio is 0.5.

(2) No retail occupancy in Area B may exceed 100,000 square feet in floor area.

(d) Density.

(1) The total combined number of retirement housing units and convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions units or suites may not exceed 500.

(2) Maximum number of retirement housing units per acre is 14.

(3) Maximum density for convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions units is 45 dwelling units or suites per acre, or 90 beds per acre.

(e) Height.

(1) Maximum structure height for Area A is 36 feet.

(2) Maximum structure height for Area B is 54 feet.

(3) Maximum structure height for Area C is 30 feet.

(4) Maximum structure height for Area D is 30 feet.

(f) Stories.

(1) Maximum number of stories for Area A is three.

(2) Maximum number of stories for Area B is two.

(3) Maximum number of stories for Area C is two.

(4) Maximum number of stories for Area D is two.

(g) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent for residential structures and 45 percent for nonresidential structures.

(h) Lot size. Minimum lot size for single family residential uses is 10,000 square feet. No minimum for nonresidential uses. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Single family lots must be landscaped in accordance with Section 51A-10.125(a).

(b) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) A landscape plan for uses other than a single family use must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Tree Preservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.112. TREE PRESERVATION.

(a) Prior to the issuance of a tree removal permit, tree preservation criteria must be met as outlined in Article X.

(b) Mitigation of tree removal must comply with Article X, except that 25 percent of the total caliper inches of preserved protected trees in Areas A, B, and D may be credited toward the total replacement requirement for Areas A and B.

(c) Areas of preserved trees must be shown on a tree mitigation plan that is to be submitted with the development plan.

(d) A tree survey of all preserved trees must be provided to the building official, and an inspection by the building official of the preserved trees must be conducted in order to be eligible to receive the 25 percent credit.

(e) If preserved trees that have been used as credit for mitigation of tree removal are permitted to be removed with a tree removal permit, mitigation of tree removal will be required at three times the normal replacement requirements. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.113. SCREENING.

(a) For a public school other than an open enrollment charter school or for a public library:

(1) a minimum six-foot-high fence must be provided along the southern boundary line of the Property adjacent to the Cliffteen Court addition.

(2) Solid screening is not required for parking lots with residential adjacency.

(b) For other nonresidential uses, a minimum nine-foot-high solid screening wall must be erected along the southern boundary line of the Property adjacent to the Cliffteen Court addition. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163; 25901)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.114. SIGNS.

(a) Areas A, C, and D. Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(b) Area B.

(1) Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(2) The only non-premise signs permitted within Area B are signs related to permitted uses within Area A. All other non-premise signs are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.115. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-568.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 568 is located on Zoning Map Nos. M-5 and M-6. (Ord. Nos. 24120; 25163)
